requirements.claim: The packaged runtime exposes one lazy typed agent-registry boundary without importing or initializing the root master_orchestrator during composition.
Existing agent modes are represented through the unified agent composition boundary.
Agent presets provide typed role and budget selection.
Built-in agent roles and dispatch integration are explicit and tested.
Delegated work carries durable parent-child lineage.

Delegation retries with a new proposed child ID propagate the canonical terminal child ID returned by the durable key registry, reuse the persisted result without a runner, and reject ambiguous duplicate terminal rows or foreign operation context.
Revisions 2 and 3 still apply; additionally, when codegen_build_loop clamps a caller-supplied attempt count, its report states the requested and applied values.

Revision 2 delegated-workspace isolation still applies; additionally, host-driven Git mutations (harness git tools and runtime-source update/stash) are serialized per working tree; an overlapping mutation or a foreign index.lock is refused without running Git and without deleting the lock, and the refusal directs re-inspection instead of a blind retry.
Structured delegation validates lineage, workspace, budgets, and result evidence.
Architect, editor, and reviewer roles are represented in the workbench review boundary.
Protocol application composition exposes one typed event vocabulary for protocol-facing surfaces.
Resumable streams validate event identity, payloads, and monotonic watermarks at the protocol boundary.
The packaged native MCP entrypoint fails closed and reports a bounded refusal before configuration when the mandatory unsafe-lab safety gate rejects the host.
OpenAI compatibility remains composed behind the provider-neutral protocol facade.
Editor and agent rule documents have a bounded, provider-neutral import/export contract.
The default control-plane graph exposes the typed memory policy matrix as bounded explanations without exposing memory content, identifiers, or recall results.
Mobile/client parity and bounded reconnect use the shared typed protocol graph.
The explicit runtime composition root exposes a protocol application facade whose client schema is bound to the same generated tool catalog and canonical snapshot-plus-events stream contract.

The live application graph exposes typed provider-neutral training and update operation entrypoints that resolve scoped providers, fail closed when a lane is absent or lacks the capability, and return normalized deployment or activation evidence.
The root fanout store is an identity compatibility alias.
Fanout persistence ownership is ratcheted to the packaged adapter.
Domain logic remains separated from adapters and interfaces.
Application ports define the attended adaptive-training side-effect boundary.
Training infrastructure failures remain behind typed process, lock, journal, policy, and deployment ports.
The remaining command, slash-menu, and permission-policy callers use packaged compatibility boundaries rather than importing root implementation modules directly.
Import side effects are constrained at the package boundaries.
Runtime configuration is represented through typed application boundaries.
The architecture ratchet rejects reintroduced retired package paths while permitting only the exact reviewed Ollama compatibility shim during caller migration.
Root compatibility paths are ratcheted against prohibited legacy exceptions.
The typed ownership catalog is wired into generated architecture authority artifacts with deterministic layer-level package, state, port, provider, schema, and lifecycle records.
Adaptive-training lifecycle sequencing is isolated from the oversized legacy root module.
Selective context eviction remains non-destructive while long-session continuation reads the immutable source stream through bounded pages.
Compaction and continuation retain exact durable source ranges while recovering a complete bounded session history across adapter pages.
Structured compaction preserves protected requirements, decisions, and failures while evicting only bulky tool output references.

Continuation refuses incomplete or tampered durable history before model assembly and archives exactly the chain-verified snapshot, so a row changed after verification cannot reach the model through a second read; legacy events above the append cap remain verifiable and reportable.
Typed modalities.
The runtime has a stable packaged identity and version boundary.
The implementation is composed as a modular monolith with enforced package layers.
Operator authority is explicit and separated from ordinary model or client input.
Local execution is the default provider and cloud use is policy-gated.
Persistence and compatibility boundaries preserve data while retiring obsolete implementation paths.
Independent authorities for tools, startup capabilities, updates, and self-modification remain explicit.
Training activation requires attended execution and qualification boundaries.
Deployment identities and model artifacts are immutable at activation boundaries.
Update activation requires trusted signed manifest verification.
The runtime uses explicit local ports and adapters rather than transplanting an external framework authority.
The live application and runtime graphs expose one provider-neutral context-planning facade.
Context assembly applies typed section budgets and a bounded model input budget.
Live continuation reads complete canonical session history through bounded pages before applying selective tool-output eviction, preserving protected requirements and decisions.
Context records are deduplicated before prefix and replay manifests are built.
Context selection returns explainable typed selections rather than opaque concatenated text.
Complete context assemblies publish an isolated last-good snapshot for bounded recovery.
Bounded continuation recovery fails closed on unavailable, non-contiguous, tampered, or over-limit history while recovering complete history across adapter pages.
Measured context capability can reduce the requested window without inventing hardware facts.

Live tool-enabled agent-lane requests keep the per-turn tool selection id outside the reusable prefix, so turns of one lane and independent worker processes on the same project derive one deterministic prefix identity; a bounded two-process loopback Ollama probe observed provider-reported prompt-cache reuse through the production gateway.
Request replay manifests bind request identity, model, retained records, prefix key, and bounded metadata.
Persistence composition models per-domain SQLite ownership through a typed graph facade.
The persistence facade rejects cross-database transaction claims rather than implying distributed atomicity.
Typed record and outbox writes share one caller-owned SQLite transaction.
Revision compare-and-set is enforced by the SQLite persistence adapter.
Migration and ownership operations remain explicit typed persistence boundaries with fail-closed validation.
Epoch/adoption coordination remains represented by explicit persistence graph and CAS seams.
Immutable artifact manifests use deterministic canonical hashes at the persistence boundary.
The architecture README directly maps the authoritative master specification, all six focused current contracts, and the three historical program documents with checked classifications and links.
SPEC-5 architecture and migration documents are labeled superseded, and the former program status is labeled historical, while all three records and decision history remain linked and intact.
New ADR records are constrained to one canonical docs/adr directory and valid date-prefixed unique IDs; the two exact historical numeric series remain preserved and frozen.
Focused contracts are documented in the generated inventory and architecture references.

Source-derived tool, command, event, configuration, MCP/OpenAI/client/event schema, and SDK/operational capability references are generated and freshness-gated directly in CI with unavailable tool sources rejected.
A checked requirement is accepted only when the same change adds or links concrete, reachable evidence and regenerates the derived requirement status.
Documentation authority checks detect stale promises and out-of-date generated references.
Evaluation is exposed as a provider-neutral application service rather than a transport or evaluator implementation.
The evaluation service accepts bounded repository/tool/memory corpus coverage through the typed inventory port.
Evaluation suite and result metrics remain typed and provider-neutral at the application boundary.
Versioned evaluation dimensions and suite identity are composed through an immutable catalog boundary.
The application evaluation service exposes deterministic trajectory replay through an injected evaluator.
Replay and proposal result contracts preserve divergence and provenance evidence at the application boundary.
Promotion evidence requires explicit gates, replay equivalence, holdout success, rollback reference, and provenance before attended promotion.
The evaluation service composes explicit shadow and canary observation transitions before promotion.
Proposal creation, submission, evaluation, approval, promotion, rejection, withdrawal, and attended rollback are exposed through one typed service.
Execution exposes one typed application facade for world binding, containment, jobs, and output handling.
Execution containment and world policy remain explicit injected boundaries with fail-closed defaults.
Persistent terminal and process-world seams are exposed through the typed execution facade.
Execution output and spill references remain bounded injected services rather than unbounded in-memory text.
Remote execution is represented only as an explicit provider seam and is not silently enabled.
Execution isolation claims are carried by typed containment/world policy rather than inferred from a process call.
Bounded extension registry and explicit production facade exposure are composed; artifact discovery and execution promotion remain out of scope.
Deterministic typed extension manifest identity/dependency validation and manifest-digest admission are implemented; cryptographic verification remains out of scope.
The live bootstrap host factory preserves a typed extension memory budget and environment through the application experiment boundary before native host startup.
Durable extension registry state preserves fail-closed admission, quarantine, disable, update, repair diagnostics, and crash evidence across reconstruction.
The live application composition publishes a durable, bounded extension inventory with manifest digest validation and repair visibility.
Ephemeral extension experiments use the bounded child host through live composition while remaining explicitly authorized and non-durable.
No automatic promotion.
The live HTTP job surface reads jobs created through the canonical application JobRegistryService and continues to resolve the same durable job after application reconstruction.
The live HTTP job surface is composed over the canonical durable registry and exposes bounded list, poll, cancel, stream, and result operations alongside the application job service.
The canonical application job registry remains readable through the live HTTP adapter after an application restart, preserving durable job identity and state across reconstruction.
The composed subprocess provider uses the existing bounded process-tree cleanup contract and preserves incomplete cleanup truth.
Composed process output uses durable monotonic watermarks with bounded previews and durable spill references while output is live and after restart.
The loop facade composes typed turn admission and lifecycle state.
Turn steps have typed open, transition, retry, completion, and reconciliation contracts.
Interception and ephemeral live events are separated from durable session facts.
The loop facade preserves an explicit durable/live event distinction and validates durable JSON facts.
Steering commands are ordered, deduplicated, and applied through the loop facade.
Loop cancellation binds child cleanup to a typed cancellation tree and reports cleanup conformance.

Revision 2 transport-retry bounds and the revision 3 web-repeat canary still apply. The codegen no-progress guard, corrected from revision 3, stops regenerating a file only when two consecutive comparable attempts produce an identical failing outcome (sorted error lines with duplicates kept) without a score improvement. Attempts whose errors are a host placeholder, truncated output, or masked by count_unreliable reset the streak and never count toward a stall.

Corrects revisions 12 and 13 after an independent review of 3d22e670. Concurrent effects in one shared run now always commit their terminal outcome and checkpoint only the settled high-water prefix; restore accepts later effects only when every effect in the run is terminal and reports journal_high_water, so restart succeeds after verified reconciliation; reconcile clears the run-wide recovery fence once nothing is unresolved; checkpoint writes require the current unfenced owner epoch and idempotent outcome replays append no generation; checkpoint generations are bounded per run; the process-start verifier reports an attached launch as completed with the live {job_id}:{pid} receipt shape.
The live application memory facade composes typed memory policy, recall, outcomes, and procedural learning classes.
Memory reads and writes cross explicit typed policy decisions before application services perform them.

Corrects revisions 4-5: the first verifier-observation insert now requires the exact private producer authorization type (a duck-typed matches() stand-in was accepted before); independence is keyed by authenticated principal and scope, so one principal's child lanes cannot reach FACT; promotion reads only indexed subject-scoped rows and a persisted verified negative demotes before any completeness bound; the managed boundary decision is sealed and resolved once; certified_after_return is refused explicitly; learning refusals carry a visible reason and cannot alter work outcomes.

Composed authoritative fact writes now require an acyclic same-source and same-project supersession link, and scoped entity and decision indexes hide the predecessor after the successor becomes effective across restart and journal rebuild.
Configured project-scoped facts expose bounded entity and decision index pages with source/version/provenance and validity filtering through the application facade and MCP surface.
The memory facade preserves the existing provider-neutral recall identity and scoped unit-of-work boundary.
Typed retrieval evaluation and bounded policy decisions remain available from the live memory application boundary.
Procedural promotion candidates are exposed through the memory facade with evidence and age/contradiction policy preserved.
The runtime graph composes one provider-neutral model gateway facade over the typed transport gateway.
Model route health and logical role selection are owned by typed application contracts.
The model facade exposes stable logical-role route bindings rather than transport-specific role names.
Provider health publication is explicit and newly composed providers remain UNKNOWN until evidence is published.
Capability routing remains an injected typed policy seam at the model facade.
Model gateway composition preserves provider-neutral request/response contracts and local fail-closed behavior.
Controlled escalation and capability routing remain explicit application policy seams rather than implicit provider fallback.
Logical roles and gateway contracts provide separate budget/routing ownership points for model callers.
Provider health snapshots are stable, typed, and available through the model facade.
The model facade leaves NPU/accelerator selection behind the typed capability-routing boundary.
Live HTTP requests can receive one typed operation context carrying correlation, principal, authority, deadline, and cancellation state.
Live HTTP chat operations emit bounded redacted typed trace records without making request handling depend on telemetry.
The live lifecycle projects typed readiness, dependency, drain, recovery, admission, and bounded telemetry state into its health snapshot.
The live lifecycle retains the typed startup-reconciliation and recovery boundary used by durable state adapters.
Graceful drain shares a fail-closed runtime admission gate with live HTTP mutation admission and retains bounded cleanup truth.
Live operation telemetry is bounded, redacted, and exposed only as a local diagnostic snapshot.
Repository intelligence exposes bounded incremental index deltas through an application facade.
The facade preserves typed language/file evidence records and ranked repository map contracts.
Repository map queries return bounded ranked projections through the CLI inspection boundary.
Multi-root repository navigation accepts provider-neutral injected LSP ports.
Repository navigation evidence and revisions remain typed at the application boundary.
Progressive evidence expansion is exposed as a bounded application operation.
The repository facade preserves multi-root ownership and navigation provider isolation.
Model gateway callers use a typed provider-neutral contract.
Tool registry and execution callers use typed capability and audit boundaries.
Filesystem callers use a typed, bounded application port.
Subprocess and terminal operations are routed through the execution-world boundary.
Sandbox operations use an explicit provider port and local adapter.
Session repository and query operations are separated from session application services.
Compaction is exposed through a typed non-destructive application boundary.
Skill registry callers are isolated behind the skill application boundary.
Subagent callers use the provider contract and durable delegation boundary.
The live application composition exposes the durable job registry, process provider, bounded recovery callback, process-tree cleanup contract, and session lifecycle linkage.
WebProvider/CredentialProvider
Attachment and spill artifacts use explicit bounded storage boundaries.
Telemetry sinks remain explicit ports owned outside domain logic.
Training, embedding, and update activation share explicit lifecycle ports.
Scoped overrides are represented as explicit lifecycle configuration.
Lifecycle transitions are composed atomically at the application boundary.
Credential acquisition and release cross an opaque-handle provider boundary and fail closed when no provider is configured.
Credential authorization is re-evaluated for concrete URLs and released after requests, with unsafe header values rejected.
Filesystem races are handled through race-resistant path validation.
Package and archive safety semantics are preserved in the packaged artifact-grounding adapter.

Bounded provenance/trust records, deterministic SBOM and inventory tamper detection, fail-closed empty trust inventory, and quarantine admission are implemented; cryptographic verification is not claimed.
Prompt-injection handling preserves provenance and policy boundaries.
Secret scanning is an explicit adapter and testable boundary.
Security validation includes fuzz-oriented malformed-input handling.
Recovery evidence is stored through a bounded repository boundary.
Evidence first.
Isolated candidate execution is wired through the live typed selfmod bridge and rejects a candidate workspace that resolves to the live repository.
Verification.
Review and deployment.
Unrestricted execution records skipped verification, reproducer, review, and isolation gates as explicit bypasses instead of fabricating evidence.
Guarded selfmod permits a local descriptive commit from a clean starting checkout and never performs an automatic remote push.
Live server turns use the typed session identity boundary for durable capture.
Completed live turns append to the canonical SQLite event stream and remain visible after reopen.
The live bridge records the typed request, user message, and model response vocabulary.
The live bridge persists the model-visible prompt, system boundary, history, tier, and request identity before replay.

A long-session continuation can reopen and recover complete durable history across adapter pages from one read snapshot, including under the production default compaction wiring and with legacy events larger than the current append cap.
The loop/session facade exposes bounded fork operations through canonical continuity service contracts.
Live continuation uses complete, integrity-verified durable history and leaves the lane recoverably blocked when the history cannot be proven.

The live application composition path injects the canonical application-owned session facade into the HTTP adapter, preserving bounded administrator-gated query, export, replay, trajectory, checkpoint, fork, and repair access over the durable repository used by capture and restart recovery.
Projection checkpoints are exposed through the typed session continuity facade.
Retention candidates and execution remain behind the bounded privacy-aware continuity boundary.
Skills are registered through a validated application registry.
Skill discovery supports deterministic index, metadata, and content levels.
Skill refresh is explicitly composed with plugin manifest updates.
Skill trust and policy decisions are preserved as explicit registry facts.
Health.
Procedural skill publication validates and records promotion evidence.
The typed tool facade is the provider-neutral gateway boundary for tool execution.
Tool execution composes schema, scope, policy, approval, deadline/cancellation, redaction, and receipt stages.
Resource-aware tool policy remains an explicit fail-closed application decision.
Tool decisions and approvals are represented as typed outcomes with explicit effects and resources.
Tool startup authorities and executor availability remain explicit; absent authorities fail closed.
Tool catalogs and generated artifact projections remain behind typed application catalog boundaries.
Tool receipts preserve requester, resource, effect, world, redaction, digest, and truthful completion fields.
Training artifacts carry reproducible manifests and digests.
Training qualification produces an explicit qualified lock.
Training datasets retain provenance and validation metadata.
Training activation is gated by evaluation and qualification outcomes.
Attended training execution carries immutable manifest and adapter evidence into a typed deployment seam.
Only an attended execution request may cross the training deployment port, after process and evidence gates.
Training adapters are cataloged with deterministic compatibility checks.
Training routes prefer cheap bounded learning paths before expensive activation.
Activation failure attempts policy restoration and attended rollback, with recovery-required journal evidence when restoration fails.
Updates have one provider-neutral application service for bounded state and release evidence.
Platform activation remains behind an injected typed activator and explicit authority boundary.
Runtime-contract and signed-release evidence are checked before update activation can proceed.
Update activation and rollback remain atomic, durable, and fail closed through injected state/activation ports.
Release evidence and verified backup are required inputs to the update application service.
